p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p).read()
old=s[s.index('# Some providers'):s.index('class Intake')]
new='''def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # The Idempotency-Key header identifies the logical payout across retries;
    # providers may mint a new event id per delivery (e.g. po_1844 -> po_1844.2).
    # Use the full key: a prefix would merge distinct payouts that share one.
    if hook.idempotency_key:
        return hook.idempotency_key
    return hook.event_id


'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_keys_sharing_a_prefix_are_distinct_payouts():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_1", "aaaabbbb-1111", amount=18_000))
    second = intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_2", "aaaabbbb-2222", amount=2_000))
    assert second.applied is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
EOF
